    Our core values

    At Optimove, our values are more than words... they're the foundation of how we work, grow, and serve our clients

    • Transparency

      We are open, honest, and forthright in how we communicate. We act with integrity and the highest level of work ethics

    • Comradery

      We rely on each other, trust one another, support each other, and have fun in the process. We act and succeed as one

    • Hunger

      Hungry for success, we aim high and play to win. We approach our work with a sense of urgency, which energizes, excites, and empowers us. We take action today to secure our vision of tomorrow

    • Good-Better-Best

      We adapt, evolve, and grow, where every day we seek to be better than we were yesterday, through incremental improvements in all that we do

    • Ownership

      We think big. We are fearless in our approach and believe anything is possible. We own our actions and are accountable for their outcomes

    The Hiring Journey

    Transparency matters. Here’s what to expect when you apply:

    • CV Screen

      We review your application to assess initial fit

    • Phone Screen

      A brief call to discuss your background and the role

    • Home Task

      Showcase your skills through a practical assignment

      * For selected positions

    • Interview Process

      1. Technical Interview
      2. Leadership Interview
      3. HR Interview

    • Reference Check

      We connect with your references to learn more about your collaboration and strengths

    • Offer

      Congratulations! We'd love to have you join our team
